description: Search open tech roles in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and remote roles open to people there, newest first. Words match the title, company, place, stack and level, with common other names (frontend finds front end, flutter finds mobile roles). Every filter is optional. One company's roles and profile come from company_roles, in a card of their own.

country.description: eg Egypt, sa Saudi Arabia, ae UAE, remote: remote roles open to people in the region

field.description: Narrower field inside a job type, for example backend, mobile, devops, ml

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page (next_offset)

pay.description: Only roles that list their pay

posted_within_days.description: Posted in the last 7, 30 or 90 days (default 90)

q.description: Search words, for example "backend golang" or "data analyst"

type.description: Job type: eng engineering, data data and AI, infra infrastructure and IT, security, product product and design

name: search_roles
title: Search tech roles
